title: declared limits
expectation: page/maxEvents/maxBytes/maxReads/timeout are explicit numbers; page < maxEvents; bounds exceed the legal 2049 history

title: maxEvents boundary legal
expectation: the declared capacity boundary itself must still recover; only maxEvents+1 may fail
actual: asOfSeq=32767 eventCount=32768 refs=1 inherited=0 reads=132 opens=1 closes=1

title: maxEvents exceeded
expectation: one event past the declared capacity rejects with a diagnosable limit error and releases the handle; it must not return a truncated history
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_LIMIT: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection history exceeds the safe read bound

title: maxBytes exceeded
expectation: a history whose serialized events exceed the declared byte bound rejects; no partial projection
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_LIMIT: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection history exceeds the safe read bound

title: maxBytes legal
expectation: a multi-megabyte history below the byte bound recovers exactly
actual: asOfSeq=5 eventCount=6 refs=0 inherited=0 reads=16 opens=1 closes=1

title: utf8 byte accounting
expectation: a history whose serialized UTF-8 bytes exceed maxBytes rejects even when its JSON character count is smaller; byte accounting is not a character count
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_LIMIT: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection history exceeds the safe read bound

refs.notes: UTF-8 bytes=50332550 > maxBytes=33554432; JS characters=16778102 <= maxBytes

title: maxReads exceeded
expectation: a backend forcing more than maxReads slices (pageCap=1) rejects with a bounded-work error rather than unbounded reads
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_LIMIT: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection history exceeds the safe read bound
